   136      rungs: Sequence[str],
   137      resolve_fn: Callable[[str, dict], str],
   138      reverify_fn: Callable[[str], str],
   139      max_rungs: int = 2,
   140  ) -> RoutingResult:
   141      """Climb the capability ladder until a strong writer CONFIRMS the finding.
   142  
   143      ``rungs``       — model labels, strongest first (from ``rank_falsifier_writers``).
   144      ``resolve_fn``  — (model_label, finding) -> falsifier_code. The caller dispatches
   145                        that model WITH the execute_python tool loop and extracts the
   146                        final falsifier. Empty string means the model produced none.
   147      ``reverify_fn`` — falsifier_code -> verdict. The runner's real decider
   148                        (falsifier_verify.reverify_falsifier). It, never the model,
   149                        decides the verdict — "tools decide".
   150  
   151      Returns a RoutingResult. ``resolved`` is True only on a CONFIRMED from the
   152      decider; otherwise the caller escalates to HIL with the diagnosis intact.
   153      A REFUTED here is NOT trusted to drop the critical (CONFIRM-only still holds):
   154      it just means this rung did not demonstrate it; we try the next rung, then HIL.
   155      """
   156      fid = finding.get("finding_id") or finding.get("id") or "?"
   157      last_verdict, last_code, last_model, tried = "UNTOOLABLE", "", None, 0
   158      for model in list(rungs)[:max_rungs]:
   159          tried += 1
   160          last_model = model
   161          code = (resolve_fn(model, finding) or "").strip()
   162          last_code = code

   167          last_verdict = verdict
   168          if verdict == "CONFIRMED":
   169              return RoutingResult(fid, "CONFIRMED", True, model, code, rungs_tried=tried)

   171      return RoutingResult(fid, last_verdict, False, last_model, last_code, rungs_tried=tried)
